info.title: JudicialSync Platform Core
info.description: Platform Core API — Identity & Access, the shared Case & Docket model, the Audit trail, the Security baseline, and Configuration. Generated code-first from the running NestJS application; the committed contract is drift-checked in CI.

tags.description: The shared case family and docket events (F01)

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: The append-only audit trail and the Audit Explorer (F02)

session.description: The session token returned by POST /auth/login.

error_code.description: Stable, machine-readable code. Clients branch on this, never on message text.

message.description: Human-readable, display-safe message — never a raw stack trace.

detail.description: Optional structured context. Never carries internal exception detail.

entitlements.description: Separately granted entitlements; a role never contributes here.
